matrix.requirement: The native video element drives playback state.
matrix.reason: video.currentTime drives shared progress for the map and timeline. An explicit seek command is distinct from progress publication, avoiding feedback seeks. Requested playback intent during buffering/error is not a second clock.

matrix.requirement: Reliable loading, seeking, and error handling.
matrix.reason: Coverage includes missing first/middle segments, manifest failures, Retry, a new healthy seek, prefetch, loops, pre-metadata seeks, route reset, and navigation cancellation. A bounded native missed-seek guard reports an unavailable selected time rather than publishing an incorrect settled clock.
matrix.limit: An actionable unavailable-time error is not restoration of missing media. The native guard is conservative and does not classify all low-readiness or empty-seekable failures.

matrix.requirement: Keep the map and thumbnail timeline.
matrix.reason: The timeline retains preview, loop, and keyboard interactions. Map mode hides loading/error overlays without replacing the video element; time, marker, and frame state are retained, and Video restores the appropriate status.
matrix.limit: Fixture map behavior is covered; live map tile availability was not independently certified.

matrix.requirement: Tasteful, modern design consistent with connect.
matrix.reason: The dark palette, grouped controls, primary circular action, narrow timestamp layout, desktop map relationship, menus, focus, and touch/desktop hover were designed and inspected. The four stable layout captures match the preceding source exactly after the final CSS-only fix.
matrix.limit: Measured visual and keyboard checks are not comprehensive assistive-technology certification or proof of every possible viewport/state.

architectureReview.videoClock: The media element owns time; explicit application seeks are distinguished from progress updates.
architectureReview.sourceLifecycle: Stale source callbacks and asynchronous play completions are guarded; navigation/unmount cancels work.
architectureReview.transport: Native HLS remains available for iOS and fallback; supported other browsers use Hls.js/MSE. Healthy buffered playback/loops survive a failed future prefetch.

nativeMissedSeekGuard.scope: Actual native adapter, latest normalized target scoped to the active source.
positiveConditions: Settled seeked event with video.seeking false.
Actual time differs from requested target by more than 0.5 seconds.
Nonempty seekable ranges exclude the target with a 0.5-second margin.
nativeMissedSeekGuard.result: Pause the media element, retain requested position and playback intent, and report the unavailable-time error before publishing the wrong clock.
nativeMissedSeekGuard.recovery: Existing explicit Retry or new-seek recovery reloads the source. There is no automatic polling, timer-based repair, or automatic reload.
nativeMissedSeekGuard.lifecycle: Completed/default targets clear; seek supersession is respected; first-available startup remains possible; late ended events do not restart a failed loop.
nativeMissedSeekGuard.limitation: Low-ready or empty-seekable events keep previous behavior; this is a bounded detector.

architectureReview.mapOverlay: Existing controlsVisible gates loading/error actions in Map mode, preserving the same video element. Hidden Retry is absent from the DOM/tab order; Video restores status.
architectureReview.finalStyleOnlyChange: A local hover fallback preserves the white primary button on hover-incapable devices while the later desktop hover rule remains light gray.
